input.title: Slowly loading thought not rendered as pending
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- a
  - b
    - c
```

Add `await sleep(2000)` to [replicateChildren](https://github.com/cybersemics/em/blob/c21cdc17813b6fe06f2e112cfc56693a34ed8b4a/src/data-providers/yjs/thoughtspace.ts#L739) to simulate a slow connection.

## Current Behavior

Thoughts are only briefly rendered as pending, then are rendered as normal bullets even though they are still loading.

https://github.com/cybersemics/em/assets/750276/5f93f26a-bb47-4179-8c02-3ce95eace879

## Expected Behavior

Thoughts that are still loading should be rendered with the pulsing animation of pending thoughts.

## Notes

This bug was fixed in a510821 but had to be [reverted](https://github.com/cybersemics/em//commit/8cd02e7bac22a604bffffc3cbce77e1fd357480e) due to a regression. Make sure to test setting the cursor on a pending thought and ensure that it does not stay permanently pending.

> This reverts commit a510821d76ed449c050e1895cd560df3af4d2738. The commit caused a regression in which setting the cursor on a thought while it was still pending would cause it to stay permanently pending. (This could be simulated by adding an artificial delay to replicateThought or fetchDescendants.)
> 
> Reverting this commit does restore some undesirable old behavior: Non-root thoughts are not initially marked as pending in fetchDescendants, so the bullet is not rendered with the pulsing animation as it should. A solution that does not cause the aforementioned regression should be re-attempted.
